pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, clear dark outlines, completely solid uniform fills. No gradients, shading or texture. One complete speaker at LEFT addressing TWO full-body listeners standing together on RIGHT, speaker's face and gaze directed toward them, open hand points to both, both listeners look back at speaker. Thin red oval surrounds only listener pair. YOU plural, flat solid fills dark outlines, no labels or words. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background. Show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. Zoom OUT, leave one sixth of canvas width empty at both sides, generous white above and below. Natural anatomically correct hands. Plain shoes and clothing. No border. Absolutely no text, writing, letters, numbers, labels, brand marks, emblems, logos or watermarks anywhere.
